invariants.rationale: Method returns a newly created HashMap which is never null.
The return type of the method is Map<String, String> and the returned object is a Map.
Key is only added if the condition is met, so result is either empty or contains the specific key.
Only non-null values from getWriteConfig().getClusteringSortColumns() are put into the map; no null values are inserted.
Keys in the map are generated from PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key(), which should never be null.
